text: You know the question. Writing the SQL is the hard part.
SayQL is for anyone who needs answers, not SQL.
Say what you need. It knows your schema.
Ask your database in plain English. The SQL appears as you type, so there's no waiting.
It knows your tables and columns, so the query fits.
Follow up in plain words, and it changes the last query.
Skills add your own rules. This one keeps personal data out.
Anything that could change data asks you first.
And if a query fails, it fixes itself.
Bigger questions? Agent mode investigates in read-only steps, and every answer cites its queries.
The Ask box never sends your data to AI. It only sees your question and your schema.
Use Claude, OpenAI or Gemini, or stay fully local with Ollama.
Claude can even query your databases through SayQL, read-only.
Free and open source. Early access at sayql.dev.
